messages:
Maya: Hey all — planning a 60m alignment huddle to walk through the API v2 changes, SDK auth flow updates, and Console Settings UX tweaks. Need reviewers and an agreed pre-read checklist.

Arjun: +1. Prefer morning. Can we do 60m or 45m?

Jess: 45m is fine if we keep it focused on decisions and open issues.

Maya: Goal: confirm API surface, SDK breaking-change plan, and Console mockups for settings modal. Bring blockers and code review links.

Lina: I can cover API contract and migration guide. I'll share pre-read by EOD.

Tom: I'll take SDK portion. Leaving a short PR link here: https://git.redwood/inference/sdk/pulls/412

Maya: Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 10:00
- Tue 14:00
- Wed 09:00
Reply with which works or add :+1: on a time.

Jess: Tue 14:00 works for me.

Arjun: Tue 10:00 for me. If majority prefers 14:00, I can shift.

Lina: Wed 09:00 is tricky — prefer Tue 14:00.

Tom: Tue 14:00 for me too.

Maya: Looks like Tue 14:00 wins. I'll book a 50m slot to keep it tight and reserve 10m buffer.

Maya: Pre-read checklist (please skim before the meeting):
```
- Read API contract doc: https://docs.redwood/inference/api-v2
- Review SDK auth PR: https://git.redwood/inference/sdk/pulls/412
- Look at Console settings mocks: https://figma.redwood.com/file/xyz
- Add any blockers to the 'design-review' board column
```

DevExBot: Reminder queued — meeting created: Calendar invite sent to participants.ics

Maya: If you're a required reviewer and can't make it, flag a delegate or add async comments in the PR. We'll do a 1-sentence decision summary at the end.

Jess: Added comments on the SDK PR.

Arjun: Will post a short migration plan doc by tomorrow morning.

Maya: Thanks — see you Tue 14:00 PST. Agenda and final pre-read links will be in the invite.
